description.value:
Light, air-veined, and exactly as fragile as that sounds.

Gift — Your Bulk counts 2 lower for anything carrying or lifting you; +2 circumstance to Acrobatics to Balance, and treat falls as 20 feet shorter. Tithe — They break. A critical hit against you that deals bludgeoning damage also inflicts clumsy 1 for 1 round.

cinderfall.incomplete: "A critical hit against you that deals bludgeoning damage also inflicts clumsy 1" has no confirmed rule-element hook: no generic 'gain a condition when critically hit by damage type X' actor-level rule element was found in pf2e-source. The Bulk-for-others'-carrying-purposes and shorter-fall clauses are correct as-is, not gaps: real pf2e ships an equally concrete falling-damage claim (Cat Fall, pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/skill/level-1/cat-fall.json) with rules: [], confirming no engine hook exists anywhere for either.
